title: Credit Risk and Portfolio EDA
problem_statement: A credit portfolio team needs to explain where delinquency and default risk concentrate before changing policy or building predictive models.
questions: Where do defaults and balances concentrate?
Are delinquency patterns monotonic across bands?
What features would leak future information?
hypotheses: Default increases with utilization and delinquency.
Exposure concentration differs from account-count concentration.
recommendations: Separate exposure-weighted and account-weighted risk views.
Audit temporal leakage before any predictive model or policy simulation.
